GEOFFS GUIDE

Release notes.

What changed, when it changed, and why.

5 NOV 2026 · 4:36PM AEDT

Share-card redesign and result-state fix

  • Fixed null revised tips incorrectly producing “Off track”; finished races now use the frozen saved tip.
  • Rebuilt the share image as one editorial race poster with a clean Geoff medallion, hero silk and state-led result treatment.
  • Removed the extra URL preview when an image can be shared and cached one generated PNG per race state.
  • Simplified the page to one honest Share card action with destination icons shown quietly.
5 NOV 2026 · 4:23PM AEDT

Race-aware sharing

  • Moved sharing to a subtle strip at the top of Form, led by the selected horses’ silks.
  • Added official WhatsApp, Instagram and Messages icons plus the native share sheet.
  • Added “I bet with Geoff”, “Geoff landed it”, “In the money” and “Off track” treatments.
  • Share cards show sourced win odds or official win/place dividends when available; missing prices are omitted.
5 NOV 2026 · 4:18PM AEDT

Sharing, clearer picks and alert testing

  • Low-evidence races now retain and name the top-ranked pick while clearly labelling confidence as low.
  • Added an “I bet with Geoff” image card containing Geoff’s photo and the current top three, shareable through the phone share sheet, WhatsApp or Messages.
  • Race alerts now verify setup with an immediate test notification and provide the required iPhone Home Screen instructions.
  • Added this dated release history.
5 NOV 2026 · 3:27PM AEDT

Clearer finished-race results

  • Made official winners and available placings prominent on the Form page.
  • Added stronger celebration when the saved tip won or finished in the top three.
  • Added sourced how-the-winner-won and why-we-missed notes where reliable reporting was available.
  • Kept completed-race recommendations frozen.
5 NOV 2026 · 2:47PM AEDT

Race-day learning

  • Added bounded comparable-race draw signals from earlier official races.
  • Added a plain-language note explaining whether today’s results changed the draw adjustment or tip.
  • Improved official, provisional and pending result labels.
5 NOV 2026 · 11:20AM AEDT

Late mail launched

  • Added saved late-mail editions, track conditions, scratchings, rider and gear changes.
  • Preserved the original baseline so revisions can be compared honestly.
  • Added sourced guide opinions and protected scheduled updates.
